goal: Verify that a user can create a new account, navigate the calendar to the previous month, and successfully create a memo with specific content.

findings.instruction: In the text input area labeled 'Any thoughts...', type the message 'Team meeting at 3 PM to discuss Q3 goals.' and click the 'Save' button.
findings.title: Memo creation failed due to incorrect element selection
findings.description: The test step intended to type text into the 'Any thoughts...' input field but the automation script incorrectly targeted a button element instead. This caused the fill action to fail, preventing the memo from being created. The expected behavior is for the text to be entered into the input field and saved.
findings.evidence: The error log shows 'Element is not an <input>, <textarea>, <select> or [contenteditable]' when attempting to fill a button. The AFTER screenshot shows no text entered in the input field and no new memo created, confirming the action did not succeed.
reproduction_steps: Navigate to the dashboard with the calendar view.
Attempt to type 'Team meeting at 3 PM to discuss Q3 goals.' into the 'Any thoughts...' field using an incorrect selector that targets a button instead of the input field.
Observe that the fill action fails and no text appears in the input field.
